title: Basel Framework — LEX (Large exposures)
sourceNote: Structured rendering of the BCBS consolidated Basel Framework, standard group LEX (large exposures). Verbatim source: https://www.bis.org/basel_framework/standard/LEX.htm. Binds the bank via SARB Reg 38 and BA 330.

sections.heading: The large-exposure limit
sections.text: The large-exposures framework limits the maximum loss a bank could face in the event of a sudden counterparty failure, constraining concentration risk.

subsections.text: The sum of all of a bank's exposure values to a single counterparty or to a group of connected counterparties must not at any time exceed 25% of the bank's available eligible capital base (Tier 1 capital). A more stringent 15% limit applies between global systemically important banks.
